items.line: **The default configuration**, `DefaultConfig()` in `config.go`, owns the canonical default values. The loading test and the schema test both use it, replacing the test helper.
items.requirement: DefaultConfig() function in config package, no args, returns *Config, same canonical defaults as loading path

items.line: **The decode hooks**, the exported `DecodeHooks`, own the conversions applied when decoding. `Load` adds its experimental-field hook to a copy, never to the shared list.
items.requirement: Decode hook chain reusable through exported DecodeHooks

items.line: **Schema durations**: every duration field takes the duration pattern, with decimals, or an integer. This includes `conn_max_lifetime`, `bootstrap.expiration`, and the audit `flush_period`.
items.requirement: Every duration setting accepted by CUE schema in Go duration string form

items.line: **The schema**, `#FliptSpec` in [`config/flipt.schema.cue`](/config/flipt.schema.cue), owns the contract: its sections, the duration pattern, and the database and git alternatives.
each of `log`, `ui`, `cors`, `cache`, `server`, `tracing`, `db`, `meta`, `authentication`, `audit`, `experimental`, and `storage` is accepted, and `version` is absent.
items.requirement: #FliptSpec accepts every top-level section emitted by decoded default (log, ui, cors, cache, server, tracing, db, meta, authentication, audit, experimental, storage)

items.line: Given the field tag `mapstructure:"flush_period,omitempty"`, **When** `fieldKey` reads it, **Then** it returns `flush_period`, so `FLIPT_AUDIT_BUFFER_FLUSH_PERIOD` binds.
items.requirement: Mapstructure field names align with schema names; omitempty must not prevent correct field name

items.line: **The tags** own what the decoded map leaves out: `omitempty` on optional fields removes empty values, so nil pointers and zero scalars never reach validation.
items.requirement: Optional empty fields in default config must not cause CUE validation failures (authentication, database, storage, tracing, audit, etc.)

items.line: **Given** the default configuration, whose storage type is empty, **When** it is decoded, **Then** `Storage.Local` and `Storage.Git` are nil, and `storage` has no `local` or `git` key.
items.requirement: Storage config supports omitted local, git, and authentication subsections without emitting invalid empty objects

items.line: | Niche      | A construction site outside `internal/config` builds `Local{}`    | none exists today; a build error there is expected, not avoided |
items.requirement: StorageConfig.Local and Git become nil-able pointers *Local and *Git, nil when not selected, populated when selected, omitted from decoded config; deliberate breaking change; source in scope must build; out-of-scope value construction sites' build errors expected

items.line: **Schema git entry**: `repository` is required, as the loader requires it. `ref` and `poll_interval` are optional, with the loader's defaults `main` and `30s`.
items.requirement: CUE schema accepts storage configs for database, git, local, including git repository settings, refs, poll intervals, and basic or token authentication

items.line: **Given** `db` with url `postgres://postgres@localhost:5432/flipt` and `max_idle_conn: 10`, **When** it is validated, **Then** it is accepted.
items.requirement: Database config accepts either URL-based or protocol/host/port/name/user based config, while allowing shared options (password, connection limits, lifetime, prepared statements)

items.line: **Given** `cors.allowed_origins` as `["foo.com", "bar.com"]`, and then as `"foo.com"`, **When** each is validated, **Then** both are accepted.
items.requirement: CORS allowed_origins accepted as list or single string

items.line: **Given** `advanced.yml`, **When** it is loaded, **Then** storage has type `git`, and `git` has repository `https://github.com/flipt-io/flipt.git`, ref `production`, poll interval 5s, and basic authentication with username `user` and password `pass`. `Storage.Local` is nil.
items.requirement: advanced.yml extended with audit, tracing otlp, and git storage, loading into exactly the stated values

items.line: **SC-001** (zero errors): Validating the decoded and adapted `DefaultConfig()` against `#FliptSpec` with concrete values returns no errors.
items.requirement: DefaultConfig() with string durations validates against #FliptSpec without errors when concrete

items.line: **Given** `Load("./testdata/default.yml")`, **When** its result is compared with `DefaultConfig()`, **Then** they are equal.
items.requirement: DefaultConfig() available in config package returning same canonical defaults as loading path (duplicate)

items.line: **When** it is decoded into a `map[string]any` with `mapstructure.ComposeDecodeHookFunc(DecodeHooks...)`, **Then** `audit.buffer.flush_period` is still a `time.Duration` of 2 minutes.
items.requirement: Decoding DefaultConfig() with ComposeDecodeHookFunc(DecodeHooks...) preserves duration fields as time.Duration before adaptation

items.line: **Given** that map with durations as strings (`"2m0s"`, `"24h0m0s"`, `"10m0s"`, `"1m0s"`, `"5m0s"`), **When** it is validated against `#FliptSpec` with concrete values required, **Then** there are no errors.
items.requirement: Duration values emitted from default valid after string conversion, e.g. 1m0s, 24h0m0s, 10m0s, 5m0s, 2m0s

items.line: **Given** `advanced.yml`, **When** it is loaded, **Then** `audit.sinks.log` is enabled with file `/path/to/logs.txt`, and `audit.buffer` has capacity 10 and flush period 3m.
items.requirement: advanced.yml extended (duplicate statement) to load into exactly the stated audit, tracing, storage values

items.line: **SC-001** (zero errors): Validating the decoded and adapted `DefaultConfig()` against `#FliptSpec` with concrete values returns no errors.
items.requirement: Validating decoded and adapted DefaultConfig() map against #FliptSpec with concrete validation completes without errors
